main_measure.name: slope of (next-day return minus coin mean daily return) on forecast, bars with forecast > 0

statistic.name: OLS slope t, day-clustered standard errors

main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 (with supporting mean > 0) confirms; slope t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean next-day return minus coin mean daily return on bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the supporting mean is above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: The regression has an intercept and its slope t uses cluster-robust (sandwich) standard errors with cases grouped by UTC day and the usual G/(G-1)*(N-1)/(N-K) correction; the coin's mean daily return is the mean of all its 1-bar returns over all its windows, and the 1-bar horizon makes every bar its own non-overlapping case.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0003694 on the check folds against +0.0005295 on every fold
